preconditions: Company: QA Chemist (any trade works: the case is tagged trade:all; the automated run uses a chemist company).
Log in as an admin user (or a role with Add / Delete rights on Accounting Trans.).
The current financial year is open and today's date lies inside it.

Ledgers needed: 'Cash Account' (default ledger) and a Bank Accounts ledger for the other side (upstream data names it 'Contra 001'; in a QA company use any bank ledger, e.g. create 'QA Bank' under Master > Ledger, group Bank Accounts). Contra moves money only between cash and bank ledgers.
Note the current balance of both ledgers: Master > Ledger, find each ledger, refresh it and read its Balance (Dr / Cr).
steps: Open Accounting Trans. > Contra (the Contra voucher list opens)
Press Create/F2 to open a new voucher; if a preferences window opens click Save, if an 'unsaved' window opens close it with x
In 'Date' keep today's date (type it as DD-MM-YYYY and press Enter)
In the first grid row click the Account cell, type 'Cash Account' in the search box of the ledger window and click the ledger
In the Credit (Cr.) amount column type 500 and press Enter
In the second grid row click the Account cell, type 'Contra 001' in the search box of the ledger window and click the ledger
In the Debit (Dr.) amount column type 500 and press Enter
In 'Narration' type 'Test credit note balanced'
Note the 'Voucher No.' shown in the header, then press End (Save); if a save window opens click Save
Open Accounting Trans. > Contra, set the date filter to 'This Week', search the noted Voucher No. and double-click the row
Check both ledgers are on the voucher, press Delete and answer Yes
expected: a green success toast appears and the voucher is saved (a print window may open: close it with x)
Master > Ledger, refresh 'Contra 001': its balance moved 500 towards Debit; refresh 'Cash Account': its balance moved 500 towards Credit
Accounting Trans. > Contra, filter 'This Week', search the Voucher No.: exactly one row, and opening it shows both ledgers in the Account column
Delete: a green success toast appears; both ledger balances are back to the values noted before the test

preconditions: Company: QA Garment (case is trade:all; the automated pack runs in the garments company). Destructive: it creates, changes and deletes vouchers, so use a QA company only
Control Room > Sale Bill Setting "Mode of Payment Required ?" = Yes (save opens the Mode Of Payment window; Cash Account 0 = credit bill)

A NEW customer ledger made only for this case (Master > Ledger, group Sundry Debtors, Balancing Method #ddlBalancingMethod = "Bill By Bill", the default for new customers), e.g. QA_OA_<case>_Cust, so the outstanding report shows only this case's documents. Do not use the shared QA_Party_Debtor: its older bills mix into the totals
A 0% GST item with stock, e.g. QA_Item_Exempt (Tax Category GST Sale-Exempt; the pack uses "QA Outstanding Exempt Item"), so Qty 1 x Rate N gives a bill of exactly ₹N
User has rights to create, modify and delete Sale Bill, Sale Return and Receipt
Scenario (OA-026): Bill Amount = ₹1,000 / Receipt = ₹400 / Sale Return = ₹300
steps: Log in, open company QA Garment and create the new Bill-By-Bill customer for this case
Open Sale > Bill and press Create/F2
In Select Party pick the test customer; in the item grid add the 0% GST item, Qty 1, Rate 1000 (Bill A amount = ₹1,000, no tax)
Press Tab on the first empty grid row, then press End (or the footer Save / F10) to save
In the "Mode Of Payment" window leave the Cash Account amount (first row, #txt-amount-0) at 0 so it is a credit bill, and click SAVE
If a Bill Adjustment window opens, click Save as proposed; in the Print window (Select Format) click Close. Note the saved Bill No. as Bill A
Open Accounting Trans. > Receipt and press Create/F2
Choose mode "Cash Account"; in the first row pick the test customer as the account; keep today's date
Type Amount 400 and press Enter; on Short Amount press Enter again: the Bill Adjustment window opens (only for a Bill-By-Bill party)
In the Bill Adjustment window click Bill A and press Space to tick it; Adjusted Amt. = 400 (type 400 in the Adjusted Amt. cell if a different value is filled)
Footer shows Adjusted Amount 400 and Pending Amount 0; click Save (F10) to close the Bill Adjustment window
Press End to save the receipt: toast "Receipt Voucher Saved Successfully !" and an empty receipt opens; note the voucher number as Receipt R1
Open Master > Ledger, select the test customer and press F8 (same view as Report > Outstanding Report > Receivable > Ledger Wise, Enter, F7 "Show All Ledger", double-click the customer)
In "<customer>- Outstanding" read each row (Station, Bill No, Bill Date, Due Date, BillAmt, Adjustment, Outstanding, Narration) and the Grand Total
expected: Outstanding (sum of the positive Outstanding rows) = 300
Advance = 0: no negative (credit) row is listed for the customer
Grand Total of the Outstanding column = 300
Each receipt save shows "Receipt Voucher Saved Successfully !"; a bill reduced by a receipt shows Narration "Agst: <bill no>" and the amount in Adjustment
Nothing outside the test customer's ledger changes
